definition: "Forever chemicals" (Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) widely used in firefighting foam and gear that resist breaking down and are linked to cancer and immune system risks.
Any substance or agent (like smoke particles or asbestos) that promotes the formation of cancer.
Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons – toxic chemicals released during the burning of coal, oil, gas, wood, garbage, and tobacco.
The study of how often diseases occur in different groups of people and why. In this context, tracking cancer rates among firefighters vs the general public.
Laws that automatically assume certain cancers in firefighters are caused by their job, simplifying workers' compensation claims.
